title.en: Modular arithmetic and algebra for computing
title.zh: 模运算与计算中的代数

lead.en: Compute gcds, prove when modular division is valid, trace repeated squaring, and distinguish integer rings, prime fields, machine words, and checksum claims.
lead.zh: 计算最大公因数，证明模除法条件，跟踪重复平方，区分整数环、素数域、机器字与校验和结论。

prerequisites.en: Modules 01 and 04: integer arithmetic, functions, induction, invariants, and termination. No graph or counting module is required for the core lesson.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 01 与 04：整数运算、函数、归纳、不变式与终止。核心不要求图或计数模块。

en: Use divisibility, unique integer quotient/remainder, and prime-factor reasoning with domains.
Compute Euclid and extended Euclid traces and verify Bézout identities.
Prove modular inverse existence and solve a small linear congruence.
Explain repeated-squaring correctness, Fermat's conditions, and a coprime CRT example.
Distinguish groups, rings, fields, binary operations, and limited checksum evidence.
zh: 明确域使用整除、唯一商余数与素因子论证。
计算欧几里得及扩展跟踪，验证贝祖恒等式。
证明模逆存在条件并解小线性同余。
解释重复平方正确性、费马条件与互素 CRT 例子。
区分群、环、域、二进制运算与有限校验和证据。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2; trace quotients and Bézout coefficients.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，跟踪商与贝祖系数。

text.en: Run gcd traces and check the identity including zero inputs.
text.zh: 运行 gcd 跟踪，检查恒等式与零输入。

title.zh: 剩余类、逆元与合法约去

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and use the residue explorer.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并使用剩余类探索器。

text.en: Read gcd, congruence, and inverse selections.
text.zh: 阅读 gcd、同余与逆元选段。

text.en: Explain why nonzero is weaker than invertible.
text.zh: 解释非零为何弱于可逆。

text.en: Read Section 5; prove the squaring invariant and solve CRT.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节，证明平方不变式并解 CRT。

text.en: Compare modular powers with Python and count operations.
text.zh: 与 Python 比较模幂并计操作。

text.en: State the exact Fermat and CRT hypotheses.
text.zh: 声明费马与 CRT 的准确条件。

text.en: Read Section 6 and compare fields with word arithmetic.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节，比较域与机器字算术。

text.en: Find noninvertible residues and explicit checksum collisions.
text.zh: 找不可逆剩余类与明确校验和碰撞。

text.en: Complete the choices and a written inverse argument.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面逆元论证。

text.en: Check the Python pow contract and complete the exit task.
text.zh: 检查 Python pow 约定并完成结业任务。
